description: List listings in a market whose item price, observed within the last 24 hours, is at least 10% below that same listing's own lowest observed daily item price in the 30 full UTC days before the day the drop was first observed (the pre-drop low), with at least 7 observed days in that window; a drop stays listed for up to 7 days, counting that first day, while the price stays at least 10% below the pre-drop low; largest relative drop first, at most 4 per shop and brand in a row (rounds: the next round follows, a round may hold fewer). The reference (reference_low_minor, reference_low_day, reference_from, reference_to, reference_series) is Tallybuy's own record of that seller's listing, never a list, recommended or former price stated by the shop. It is an observed change, not a price reduction announced by the seller: do not call it a discount, sale, saving or reduced price. Item price only: delivery is not included and is unknown here. Each drop names its seller (merchant_name) and observed_at, the observation time, not live: cite both. Money is a string of minor units (item_price_minor, reference_low_minor, drop_minor) with currency_exponent decimals; null is unknown, never zero. Only sources that permit assistant access are included, and seller_count counts those. Follow next_cursor while has_more. market_id and currency are required: take them from list_markets; locale is optional and names the label language. Use list_offers instead with the drop's variant_id for delivered totals, every seller and the purchase_url; use get_price_history instead for one variant's full series.

currency.description: Required: the market default_currency from list_markets

cursor.description: Opaque service cursor from the previous page

locale.description: Optional published locale from list_markets for product labels

market_id.description: Required: active market UUID from list_markets

name: list_price_drops
title: List observed price drops
